alt: A long job in ELU: the agent starts a long test run as a job and ends its turn, the job keeps running, and when it ends ELU starts the session again by itself and the agent reports the result.

frames.caption: You ask for the full test run.
The agent wants to run it as a job. You allow it with y.
The turn ends. The job keeps running.
The job ends. ELU starts the session again by itself.
The agent reads the result and reports.
